title: Barrier Removal Growing Institutional Capacity
overview: This funding helps institutions strengthen systems that remove barriers for students who are struggling to meet their basic needs, including access to food, housing, transportation, childcare, and other essential supports. Eligible applicants include Community Colleges, Tribal Colleges, Public Colleges and Universities, and Nonprofit Organizations partnering with a College/University. Proposals requesting funds to strengthen systemic institutional capacity to remove life barriers and poverty-related barriers to students will be evaluated based on the presence of sound design principles, a clear plan for building institutional capacity grounded in evidence and data, commitment to strengthening community partnerships, a plan for cross-silo communication/collaboration, and a plan for sustaining capacity beyond the end of the grant. Applications must be submitted through the EGrAMS Portal two weeks before the deadline. The paper form application is for planning purposes only. Show More
